claim_template: The analysis includes {n} adjudications from {events} events after excluding {excluded} records.
population: formal Race and Sprint driving-conduct adjudications 2018-2025
required_method: deterministic population flow and exclusion audit
minimum_acceptance: 100 percent source lineage and explicit exclusion reason
required_sensitivity: alternate handling of unresolved corrected or recalled documents
primary_limitation: Formal referral is required for inclusion

claim_template: After adjustment the probability of a sanction differed by {magnitude} between otherwise comparable cases; {interval}.
population: formally adjudicated primary incident families
required_method: grouped validated penalized logistic model
minimum_acceptance: calibration acceptable and event-grouped validation beats prevalence baseline
required_sensitivity: leave-one-season-out and alternate context specifications
primary_limitation: Unpublished evidence and referral selection remain unobserved

claim_template: {n} adjudications met the frozen high-priority residual and support thresholds for manual review.
estimand: count above frozen anomaly and support thresholds
population: model-eligible adjudications
required_method: calibrated residual plus comparable-case support
minimum_acceptance: thresholds frozen before case inspection and each case has complete evidence
required_sensitivity: alternate model families and exclusion of low-support rows
primary_limitation: Model disagreement does not establish incorrect stewarding

claim_template: Among {mappable_n} confidently mappable 2025 adjudications {share} were within the published baseline or range.
population: 2025 public-guideline-mappable primary adjudications
required_method: double-reviewed rule mapping
minimum_acceptance: at least 90 percent coding agreement or reconciled disagreement
required_sensitivity: strict versus broad mappability definitions
primary_limitation: Guidelines are non-regulatory and public only for 2025

claim_template: {n} 2025 decisions were apparent unexplained departures from the public guideline range.
estimand: count of confidently mapped unexplained departures
population: 2025 public-guideline-mappable adjudications
required_method: double-reviewed written-decision audit
minimum_acceptance: every case independently reviewed with applicable version verified
required_sensitivity: reclassify unclear as conformant and as departed bounds
primary_limitation: Public reasons may omit evidence considered by stewards

claim_template: The adjusted sanction probability associated with British accused-driver status was {effect}; {interval}.
estimand: average marginal effect of British accused status
population: model-eligible referred adjudications
required_method: predefined adjusted model with uncertainty and grouped validation
minimum_acceptance: adequate overlap and simulation-based power with interval reported
required_sensitivity: exclude each British driver season British GP and home races
primary_limitation: Association is conditional on referral and cannot prove bias

claim_template: The adjusted association for British affected-driver status was {effect}; {interval}.
estimand: average marginal effect of British affected status
population: model-eligible adjudications with a principal counterparty
required_method: predefined adjusted model separate from accused role
minimum_acceptance: adequate overlap and power with role definition stable
required_sensitivity: alternate counterparty rules and incident-family restrictions
primary_limitation: Counterparty attribution can be ambiguous in multi-car incidents

claim_template: Same-nationality panel exposure was associated with {effect}; {interval}.
estimand: adjusted marginal association for shared nationality
population: adjudications with verified complete steward panels
required_method: hierarchical or penalized model with panel structure
minimum_acceptance: low missingness and no complete separation
required_sensitivity: alternate nationality crosswalk and leave-one-panel-out
primary_limitation: Collective votes are not public and assignments may be correlated with event

claim_template: Post-session penalties mechanically changed {positions} positions {points} points {podiums} podiums and {wins} wins.
estimand: sum of exact narrow classification arithmetic
population: post-session sanctions with complete official classifications
required_method: deterministic same-lap re-ranking
minimum_acceptance: 100 percent arithmetic reproduced and independently reviewed
required_sensitivity: alternate tie and bonus-point rules
primary_limitation: Does not simulate changed strategy or behavior

claim_template: An additional {n} sanctions had bounded or modeled effects and {d} were not estimable.
population: all included sanctions with possible sporting consequence
required_method: tiered impact classification and validated models where used
minimum_acceptance: no mechanical language for served or future-event sanctions
required_sensitivity: report each tier separately and omit model if validation fails
primary_limitation: In-race counterfactuals depend on strategy traffic and response

claim_template: {n} adjudications were formally corrected reviewed or appealed and {changed} changed outcome.
population: all discovered versioned decision lineages
required_method: deterministic lineage resolution
minimum_acceptance: all versions linked or explicitly unresolved
required_sensitivity: strict final-only and inclusive lineage definitions
primary_limitation: Challenges are selective so this is not an overall error rate

claim_template: The evidence {supports_or_does_not_support} a conclusion of systematic inconsistency after accounting for observable case mix.
population: primary study population
required_method: frozen synthesis rule using claim-level evidence grades
minimum_acceptance: no unresolved contradiction among headline analyses
required_sensitivity: restrict by era incident family and evidence completeness
primary_limitation: Observable adjustment cannot eliminate unmeasured evidence or selection

claim_template: Official or timing evidence identified {position_n} affected-driver position losses {repair_n} incident-responsive repair stops {damage_n} confirmed damage cases and {retirement_n} incident-caused retirements.
estimand: descriptive count by independently reviewed harm dimension
population: affected-driver incident pairs linked to a formal adjudication
required_method: source-tiered harm coding with reproduced before-after timing
minimum_acceptance: 100 percent source lineage and independent review with modeled and observed totals separated
required_sensitivity: strict versus plausible incident-response links and exclusion of timing-only damage claims
primary_limitation: Observed harm does not prove fault or identify a no-incident race outcome

claim_template: Among {eligible_n} fault-established incident-driver pairs {asymmetry_n} crossed a preregistered harm-sanction review threshold on at least one reported dimension.
estimand: count of multimetric proportionality review signals
population: fault-established incident-driver pairs with reviewed victim harm and sanction burden
required_method: side-by-side seconds positions points repair and retirement comparison without a composite score
minimum_acceptance: responsibility and both impact tiers independently reviewed with nominal and realized sanction burden shown
required_sensitivity: exclude modeled pace loss and vary clean-lap windows pit-stop bounds and realized-burden definitions
primary_limitation: Penalties are not necessarily restorative and consequence policy may differ by era or decision

claim_template: The public Race Control feed contains {episodes} process episodes and {links} high-confidence links to primary adjudications.
population: Race and Sprint public timing-feed messages 2018-2025
required_method: deterministic episode construction and auditable decision linkage
minimum_acceptance: all unmatched episodes and decisions retained with human validation before inference
required_sensitivity: vary episode-gap and link-score thresholds
primary_limitation: The public feed does not contain every on-track act or internal FIA referral

claim_template: FIA incident clocks mapped {mapped} of {cases} cases to lap windows and contained all {validated} previously known laps.
population: model-reviewed primary adjudications with Race or Sprint timing
required_method: timezone-aware interval mapping with known-lap validation
minimum_acceptance: 100 percent containment on known laps and uncertainty preserved
required_sensitivity: vary minute-window and pre-start tolerance
primary_limitation: Single-lap mappings still require source review before use as final incident facts

claim_template: {supported} cases have at least five outcome-blind close neighbors under the frozen context match.
population: primary adjudications within exact family session and guideline cells
required_method: outcome-blind matching with post-match outcome attachment
minimum_acceptance: no outcome-derived match fields and human-reviewed context
required_sensitivity: alternate distance weights and minimum-neighbor thresholds
primary_limitation: A different neighbor outcome is a review lead rather than proof of inconsistency

claim_template: Collision screening produced {participants} driver-level harm records and {pace_n} estimable teammate-relative pace screens.
population: participants in reportable collision decisions
required_method: driver-specific incident timing and same-lap clean teammate comparisons
minimum_acceptance: timing kept separate from confirmed damage and all released claims independently reviewed
required_sensitivity: three five and eight-lap windows with strategy and neutralization exclusions
primary_limitation: Timing patterns cannot establish damage causality or the no-incident counterfactual

claim_template: The strict model audit reviewed {included} included decisions and {exclusions} sampled exclusions; all {sources} records cite an FIA source and {corrected} included rows changed.
population: frozen Study v2 included population plus sampled exclusions
required_method: source-derived field checks with adversarial exceptions and immutable correction lineage
minimum_acceptance: 100 percent exact FIA citation coverage zero unresolved adversarial checks and explicit model-led disclosure
required_sensitivity: re-run without correction overrides and report all publicly unavailable labels
primary_limitation: The audit is GPT-5.6 Sol model review and does not estimate independent human agreement

claim_template: All {blame_n} wholly or predominantly blame findings produced a sanction and all {racing_n} racing-incident findings produced no further action.
estimand: descriptive mapping from written responsibility finding to formal outcome
population: model-reviewed primary Race and Sprint decisions
required_method: exact source-cited cross-tabulation using strict-reviewed fault and outcome fields
minimum_acceptance: complete cited population and zero contradictory rows
required_sensitivity: combine and separate explicit fault categories and retain ambiguous categories
primary_limitation: Internal coherence does not independently establish that the written fault finding was correct

claim_template: Of {mappable_n} 2025 sanctions {plain_n} were plainly within public guidance {context_n} were within range with context and {review_n} substitutions or escalations required more context.
population: source-cited 2025 primary and secondary sanctions with a contemporaneous public comparison
required_method: decision-level source and guideline comparison without retrospective application
minimum_acceptance: all cases cite the active public guideline and context-dependent cases remain unresolved
required_sensitivity: plain-only versus context-inclusive summaries
primary_limitation: The audit is model-led and public reasons may omit evidence considered by stewards

claim_template: The nearest available match shared the direct sporting-penalty result in {same_n} of {supported_n} supported cases and differed in {different_n}.
estimand: nearest-neighbor direct-penalty agreement among supported cases
population: primary decisions with at least five outcome-blind neighbors
required_method: exact family session and guideline matching plus pre-outcome context distance
minimum_acceptance: neighbor graph frozen before outcomes and all differences labeled review priorities
required_sensitivity: alternate neighbor counts and distance-field completeness
primary_limitation: Warnings and reprimands remain formal sanctions but are separated from penalties with direct race-time or grid burden; disagreement is not an inconsistency rate

claim_template: Of {different_n} nearest-neighbor direct-penalty differences {fault_n} had different written fault findings {unclear_n} had no explicit fault threshold in either ruling and {advantage_n} involved off-track advantage context.
population: nearest outcome-blind matches with different direct sporting-penalty results
required_method: post-match comparison of source-reviewed fault labels with source-cited controversy reading
minimum_acceptance: all categories sum to the frozen disagreement count and remain review categories rather than error labels
required_sensitivity: reclassify warnings and reprimands as direct penalties and vary neighbor support threshold
primary_limitation: The categories locate where explanations are needed but do not independently establish whether the underlying fault findings were correct
